paragraphs.text: Adana Washington is a writer, tarot reader, and aspiring game developer from Houston, Texas, USA. She's the creator of the Kinetic Tarot Deck and the author of a few books on the subject of Tarot .

Adana Washington got her first tarot deck on her eighteenth birthday, and has been in love with it ever since. Her frank, witty, and slightly profane style of reading comes through in her writing as well as her readings. When she's not doing tarot readings, Adana can be found drawing and blogging.
Adana Washington contributed to the Magic Story for Strixhaven: School of Mages .
